machine.disk: File System Personality=APFS; Protocol=Apple Fabric; Solid State=Yes

dataset: Takei 2025 cerebellum rep 1 whole-cell subsets (b_storage.json); 1e8 = rep 1 replicated (replicate_store.py, flag 'replicated')
analysis: exact median 3-D distance map of chr11 (uchrom.fea.distance_map, stat='median')

modes.streaming: ChromData.read(store, backed=True) then distance_map(cd, chrom, memory_budget=budget): iter_traces(chrom, columns='coords') batches, exact median per row band
modes.chrom_memory: identity reference where load-all does not fit: get_chrom(chrom, columns='coords') in memory, then distance_map(streaming=False)

load_all_infeasible.reason: the whole 1e8-spot store in memory needs about 10x the peak of the 1e7 full read (b_storage.json), more than the 64 GB of RAM
